_comment: Read by scripts/title_screen.gd for the title screen's update-log card. `version` must match application/config/version in project.godot - a probe checks it, so a release cannot ship a label from another build. `entries` are one line each: the card clips, it does not wrap.
entries: Falling-block cover between the title and the world
Greedy-meshed chunks with three LOD tiers
Coloured block light, and a sky under roofs
Water and lava that flow, pool and wake neighbours
Paste .schem and .litematic builds into the world
